d: The world is watching Shenzhen, China, as the APEC summit brings together three of the most powerful leaders- US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Their expected meeting has sparked comparisons with the historic 1945 Yalta Conference, raising questions about whether Washington, Moscow and Beijing could reach an understanding that reshapes the global balance of power.
